shortcut_name: three-vertex obstruction reduces to a clique test
evidence: DeepSeek: "Find lexicographically smallest triangle"; GLM: "We need to find a triangle (3-clique)"; GPT: checks common adjacency; Qwen: "find a triangle in the complement graph"
affordance_in_statement: Specifically, you must find three sensors such that, no matter how you allocate them between the two frequency bands, at least one pair among these three sensors will both share an interlock and be placed in the same band.
removal_suggestion: No semantics-preserving rewording can remove this reduction: with exactly three vertices and two bands, an unsatisfiable pairwise-not-equal constraint set is intrinsically a triangle. Only changing the core task, such as requiring a larger or global obstruction, would defeat it.

survivor_shortcuts.affordance: a group of exactly three distinct sensors and two frequency bands

common_affordance: The contradiction is an intrinsic three-vertex pairwise constraint pattern, equivalent to a triangle in the interlock graph.
